Invoice Receipt Management

Legacy
• PDF invoices received by email: APS OCR
• Local e-invoicing compliance solutions (e.g., Docapost, Tax Cube, KPMG)
• Tungsten EDI in the US and parts of France
• I-Supplier portal receiving invoices in Cavite, Philippines, Oracle-based

Target UNIFY & Titan
• Supplier portals: Coupa and SupplyOn
• PDF invoices received by email: APS OCR (used with Coupa) / Ariba OCR + KTA for segregation
• EDI / supplier integration: SupplyOn
• CXML EDI integration to Coupa
• PO flip invoicing: Coupa and SupplyOn
• Government e-invoicing portals: SAP DRC
• Evolve invoice capture from template-based APS OCR to AI-based invoice recognition, replacing APS OCR for Coupa indirect procurement; Ariba OCR already uses AI for direct procurement
• AI agents for FERP OCR invoice-reception exception processing
• Common collector mailbox implementation
AI document understanding: Rossum, Tungsten, SAP Ariba OCR, Agentic AI
